target.title: refactor(gateway): consolidate client contracts
target.body:
Related: #100977

## What Problem This Solves

The core gateway client and the shared gateway-client package maintained parallel option, event, error, validation, and connection-metadata contracts. That duplication made the internal client boundary easy to drift and required core-specific casts and repeated frame guards.

## Why This Change Was Made

This makes `@openclaw/gateway-client` the canonical client contract owner and moves lightweight inbound frame validation to the published `@openclaw/gateway-protocol/frame-guards` leaf. The core facade now retains only OpenClaw-owned dependency injection and defaults. The dedicated leaf avoids pulling the large TypeBox schema runtime into the reusable client, while the package build, TS/Vitest resolution, and plugin source-loader entries cover the repository’s existing resolution modes.

The recovery pass removed an unnecessary exported request-frame validator: request IDs are generated internally with `randomUUID()`, so its ID failure branch was unreachable, and the only caller-supplied field (`method`) is now validated directly at the client boundary. The complete PR is now net negative: 208 additions / 239 deletions (net -31).

## User Impact

No user-visible runtime behavior changes. Maintainers get one canonical gateway client contract path, preserved permissive inbound frame handling, private connection secrets, and fewer duplicate declarations and one-use helpers.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwwwheyp616mww2kq518dvs4` (`silver-lobster`): 278 focused tests passed (18 package/protocol unit, 183 gateway, 77 plugin loader aliases).
- `@openclaw/gateway-protocol` build passed and emitted the lightweight `frame-guards.mjs` plus declarations.
- `@openclaw/gateway-client` build passed.
- Repository root `OPENCLAW_RUN_NODE_SKIP_DTS_BUILD=1 node scripts/tsdown-build.mjs` passed.
- Targeted `oxfmt --check` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh recovery autoreview found no actionable findings and confirmed the generated UUID makes the removed ID validator unnecessary (`patch is correct`, confidence 0.84).
- Fresh full-branch autoreview found no actionable findings and confirmed the remaining leaf/export/alias/build surfaces are aligned (`patch is correct`, confidence 0.86).
- Prior broad `check:changed` passed all pre-type guards; current exact-head GitHub CI is the broad validation source after the current-main rebase.
